notes.title: Rune Dice - Update v0.29 Changelog
notes.content:
1. Changed Vampire Dice - now heals for 50% of the dice value
2. Added different visuals for different heroes
3. Added a new hero
4. Added new relic: Persistent Venom
5. Added new relic: Infectious Bomb
6. Added new relic: Shattering Cold
7. Added new relic: Deep Freeze
8. Changed shop prices for better game balance
9. Added more game speed options for customizing your gameplay experience
10. Added sounds for opening the new dice selection menu from treasure chest, dice upgrade, and shop reroll
11. Fixed a bug where the bomb sound wasn't affected by the general sound settings
12. Added menu button to the character selection screen
13. Implemented auto-sorting of runes in inventory from high to low values
14. Added map scrolling with the mouse wheel
15. Added a "+1" icon to the dice upgrade screen for better clarity
16. Added Steam wishlist button to the main menu
17. Increased the size of the menu button to reduce accidental misclicks
18. Minor changes to tooltip texts
19. Minor UI improvements

All these changes aim to improve gameplay experience, add more strategic options, and make the interface more user-friendly. Thank you for your continued support and feedback that helps us make the game better!

notes.title: Rune Dice - Update v0.28 Changelog
notes.content:
Hi friends!

1. Added new special dice: Big Bada Boom - a powerful bomb that occasionally appears on the field, deals damage to ALL enemies equal to the merge value, and creates a strong explosive wave pushing adjacent dice.
2. Updated Treasure Chest dice - renamed and improved the description for the special dice that allows choosing one of three new dice to add to your collection.
3. Updated sound effects - improved audio feedback for shield damage and stun effects for better gameplay experience.

These changes aim to add more strategic options and improve clarity in game mechanics. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Rune Dice - Update v0.27 Changelog
notes.content:
Hey friends!

Her is what we've done with the new build:

1. Added sound settings - now you can adjust or disable sound effects and music volume in the settings menu
2. New special dice: Blind Dice - deals double damage based on merge value, but targets a random enemy
3. 5 new relics that give a chance to replace your regular master dice with special ones (healing, shield, poison, and others)
4. Updated hero starter sets - now include more dice and relics
5. Added shop refresh button for coins
6. Changed relic prices for better balance
7. Improved event nodes with questions - now always contain all dice types, instead of randomly featuring only one type
8. Updated icons for "New Dice" and "Upgrade Dice"
9. Improved vampire dice description for better clarity
10. Added table reset information in the enemy dice description
11. Removed explosion effects when merging bomb dice

All these changes aim to improve balance, add variety, and eliminate confusion in game mechanics. Thank you for your support and feedback that helps us make the game better!

notes.title: Major Gameplay Update: Dice Collection System
notes.content:
We've completely reworked the core mechanics of Rune Dice with this update! Here's what's new:

- Dice are now the collectible element instead of runes. The game now places regular dice on the table along with all dice from the player's collection.
- 10 unique dice types have been added, each with its own special effects. Players can collect these throughout their runs and build custom decks.
- The new dice value upgrade system allows players to power up their dice during gameplay, making them stronger as the run progresses.

These changes provide players with much more strategic depth:

- More meaningful decisions about where to aim and throw the dice
- Greater flexibility in building your collection - focus on aggressive or control strategies
- Increased variety in deck building - target the first enemies in line or the ones at the back

We believe these changes make Rune Dice more engaging and strategic, giving players more agency over their gameplay experience!
